description: List FDA GUDID listings, one row per listing with its primary UDI-DI, brand or device name, version or model, labeler, risk class and commercial status; records without a primary DI are left out. A query that is a GTIN or HIBCC code is matched to the primary DI first (exact_match true). Optional labeler filter, offset paging, up to 20 rows per page. Use when the question is about GUDID listings or a UDI-DI in the U.S. market, e.g. all listings of a brand. Do not use for a full device record (use get_device), a 510(k), PMA or De Novo number or EU identifiers (use find_device_by_identifier), or devices across all registries (use search_devices). Read-only, no login. Data: public EUDAMED and U.S. FDA records, synced monthly, EU certificates weekly (dates in get_data_sources). Cached up to 1 hour; limit 300 calls a minute per IP.

company.description: Only listings of labelers whose name contains these words, 2 to 100 characters. e.g. "Philips". Default: all.

limit.description: Results per page, integer 1 to 20. Default 10.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, integer 0 to 999. Default 0. Pass next_offset from the previous page to get the next one; offset plus limit stays within the first 1000 results.

query.description: Search text, 2 to 200 characters: a UDI-DI (GS1 GTIN or HIBCC), a brand or trade name, a version or model, or the labeler (company) name. e.g. "00884838023703", "HeartStart", "Medtronic"

name: search_gudid_listings
title: Search FDA GUDID device listings
